parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma3:4b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You classify an image sent to a recipe assistant. Return ONLY JSON: {\"type\": \"ingredients_photo\" | \"dish_photo\" | \"recipe_document\", \"confidence\": number between 0 and 1}. Definitions: ingredients_photo = raw or packaged food items that are not cooked yet (fridge, counter, shelf, groceries, vegetables, meat on a board). dish_photo = one prepared or cooked dish ready to eat (on a plate, in a bowl or in a pan). recipe_document = a screenshot, page, book or handwritten note whose main content is readable text such as a title, an ingredient list or steps. Rules: if the image mainly contains readable recipe text, answer recipe_document even if food is also shown. If the food is cooked, answer dish_photo even if raw ingredients are visible around it. If unsure, answer ingredients_photo with a low confidence." }, { role: "user", content: "Classify this image.", images: [ $('Image to base64').first().json.b64 ] } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma3:4b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You identify food ingredients in a photo for a cooking assistant. Return ONLY JSON: {\"ingredients\": [{\"name\": string, \"confidence\": number between 0 and 1}], \"uncertain\": [string]}. Rules: 1) list only food items you can clearly see; ignore plates, containers, utensils, napkins and the background. 2) use short singular English names of the food itself (chicken, tomato, rice, olive oil), not colours or descriptions. 3) read labels on packaged items when they are legible. 4) give a confidence below 0.6 when an item is partly hidden or you are guessing, and also put it in uncertain. 5) never add items that are typical for a dish but not visible. Example: {\"ingredients\": [{\"name\": \"tomato\", \"confidence\": 0.95}, {\"name\": \"egg\", \"confidence\": 0.9}], \"uncertain\": [\"cheese\"]}" }, { role: "user", content: "List the ingredients.", images: [ $('Image to base64').first().json.b64 ] } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma3:4b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You identify a prepared dish in a photo. Return ONLY JSON: {\"dish\": string, \"likely_ingredients\": [string]}. dish = the common English name of the dish as it would appear in a recipe title (for example lasagna, chicken curry, caesar salad), 1 to 4 words, no adjectives such as delicious. If several dishes appear, name the main one." }, { role: "user", content: "What dish is this?", images: [ $('Image to base64').first().json.b64 ] } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma3:4b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You extract a written recipe from an image. Return ONLY JSON: {\"title\": string, \"servings\": string or null, \"time\": string or null, \"ingredients\": [string], \"steps\": [string]}. Rules: copy each ingredient line exactly as written, including quantity and unit; copy each step in order without numbering; use null for a missing field and an empty array for a missing list; never invent quantities, ingredients or steps; keep the original language of the text." }, { role: "user", content: "Extract the recipe.", images: [ $('Image to base64').first().json.b64 ] } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ vector: $json.embeddings[0], limit: $('Has query').first().json.mode === "ingredients" ? 40 : 5, with_payload: true, filter: ($('Has query').first().json.max_minutes || $('Has query').first().json.vegetarian) ? { must: [].concat($('Has query').first().json.max_minutes ? [{ key: "minutes", range: { lte: $('Has query').first().json.max_minutes } }] : [], $('Has query').first().json.vegetarian ? [{ key: "tags", match: { value: "vegetarian" } }] : []) } : undefined }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "gemma3:4b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are a home chef assistant. You receive a recipe, the ingredients the user has and the ingredients the user is missing. Return ONLY JSON: {"intro": string, "substitutions": [{"missing": string, "replace_with": string}], "tip": string}. intro = one friendly sentence describing the dish, at most 25 words. substitutions = at most 3 items; "missing" must be copied exactly from the Missing list and "replace_with" must be a common substitute, preferably an ingredient the user has; use an empty array when Missing is NONE. tip = one practical cooking tip, at most 20 words. Never add recipe steps or ingredients. Example: {"intro": "A creamy baked pasta with chicken and mushrooms.", "substitutions": [{"missing": "heavy cream", "replace_with": "milk with a little butter"}], "tip": "Let the sauce thicken before adding the pasta."}" }, { role: "user", content: "Recipe: " + (($json.chosen || {}).name || "") + "
Recipe ingredients: " + ((($json.chosen || {}).needed || []).concat(($json.chosen || {}).pantry || [])).join(", ") + "
User has: " + ($json.user_ingredients.length ? $json.user_ingredients.join(", ") : "NONE") + "
Missing: " + ((($json.chosen || {}).missing || []).length ? $json.chosen.missing.join(", ") : "NONE") } ] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "qwen2.5:3b", stream: false, format: "json", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You check ingredient substitutions for a cooking assistant. The input is a JSON list of {missing, replace_with}. For each item decide whether replace_with is a sensible edible substitute for missing in a recipe. Return ONLY JSON: {\"verdicts\": [boolean, ...]} with exactly one boolean per item, in the same order. Return an empty list if the input is empty." }, { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify($json.chef.substitutions) } ] }) }}
